Based on the provided context, I'd like to clarify that all sepsis patients indeed require lactate measurement within 1 hour. This is in line with the Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) guidelines, which recommend lactate measurement as part of the initial assessment for sepsis patients. 

Source: "Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock: 2016." Intensive Care Med 42 (2016): 361-375. doi: 10.1007/s00134-016-4414-1
